# Honora Hollis

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Honora is a radiant blonde woman. She dresses stylishly, wearing silk clothing on visits.

_Sources: [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Honora possesses a bright and friendly disposition. She enjoys social life and giggles easily with her companions. Though she holds a serious outlook on existence, she is deeply supportive of her friends.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P23](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0023), [v3 c4 P25](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0025), [v3 c5 P1](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0001), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003)_

## History

Honora Hollis attended Regent's Academy with Nell Harcourt. She was later assigned as the schoolteacher in Delford. During her time teaching, she drove out to visit Nell Harcourt at Grey Shutters alongside her aunt, Mrs. Charlotte E. Varley, and Mrs. Pendexter. Later, she enrolled as a student at Wexcombe College alongside Nell, where both girls became deeply involved in classes, social activities, and the Freshmen class spirit. While visiting Old St. John's cemetery at Wexcombe, Honora and Nell struck up an immediate friendship with Cressida Lindsay, who introduced them into wider social circles. Honora also consulted with Nell over Mabel Colby's proposal to lease a small home together in Portmaris with Mabel's Aunt Euphemia.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 c20 P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024), [v3 c4 P19](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0019), [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020), [v3 c4 P29](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0029), [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c9 P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)_
